notes.title: Gravewatch Delayed to 2026 | Crowdfunding Starts Sept 29
notes.content:
Gravewatch is Delayed to 2026 💔
Hey everyone,

I’m sorry to announce that Gravewatch is being delayed to 2026.

This wasn’t an easy decision. As a solo developer, I’ve been funding the game out of pocket using my disability pension. That’s helped keep the project alive, but my resources have run completely dry. Without that final bit of funding, I can’t meet the original release window. I’ve also been dealing with recurring health issues, which have pushed development back even further.

That said, interest in Gravewatch continues to grow, and I want to deliver the experience this game truly deserves.



To help make that happen, I’ll be launching a crowdfunding campaign on BackerKit starting September 29. The more we raise, the sooner I can finish the game without cutting corners.

👉 If you'd like to support the game, you can follow the campaign now to get notified when it goes live: https://www.backerkit.com/call_to_action/b03201de-fb43-42d2-a35a-3ffa58d35db9/landing



I know delays can be disappointing, and I truly appreciate your continued patience and support... it means more than I can put into words.



I’m currently working on a revamped version of the demo and the official story trailer, so please stay tuned. Thank you again for sticking with me on this journey 🖤

notes.title: Help bring Gravewatch to life!
notes.content:
Gravewatch is Coming to BackerKit!


Gravewatch is approaching its final stages of development, and you have the chance to be part of it.

I am launching a crowdfunding campaign on BackerKit to help bring the game across the finish line. Whether it is funding the rest of the soundtrack, upgrading animations, or adding new collectibles, your support will help shape the future of Gravewatch.


🎁 Supporters will be able to claim exclusive rewards, including:
A Steam key for the full game

3-day early access

Unique in-game items

The chance to have your name, or even a photo, appear in the world

The campaign will launch once it gathers enough followers. Following it now helps a lot, as BackerKit ranks campaigns based on early interest, so every follow boosts visibility and momentum.

👉 Follow the campaign here

Following is free and takes just a few seconds.



I am incredibly excited to show you what is coming next. If you have enjoyed the demo, love horror, or simply want to support a solo developer working on an ambitious horror game, now is the perfect time to do so.

Thank you for your support, and stay tuned for more news from Gravewatch.

notes.title: Gravewatch Release Date!
notes.content:
Gravewatch will release on September 30th, 2025!

A brand new trailer is here, and with it, a new version of the demo! This updated demo is a massive step up from previous versions and includes:
- Real voice acting
- Brand new or reworked locations
- New mechanics and collectibles
- Huge improvements to the UI and the main menu
- New animations and polish of the main characters
- Better graphics and performance

... and much, MUCH more!

For the past few months, you’ve been hearing a lot about the development of Gravewatch, and now, I would like to hear from you... The game has been moved to a standalone demo page, meaning that from now on, you can leave a public review of the demo!

Whether you like the new version or not, I would be glad if you could take a couple of minutes and be one of the first to review this game, as every piece of feedback is highly appreciated! ♡

Trailer YouTube link →  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wi6rjfC-SA0

Stay tuned for more news about Gravewatch!

So, if you speak one of the listed languages and want to increase the chance of a full localization, then don't hesitate to share Gravewatch with other players from your country! Also, If you know someone who would like to help with the translation to the missing languages then feel free to write me a DM on Discord or contact me on my email: gravewatch18@gmail.com

Follow my socials for more news from the development! ♡

notes.title: Massive Demo update
notes.content:
As I am slowly working on the full game, I have gathered a lot of valuable feedback from the demo. I have used this feedback to, not only improve the full game but also the demo, and now that the "Czech & Slovak" game week is around the corner, I figured it would be a great time to upload a new, fresh version of the demo. Major parts of the demo have been reworked to closer resemble what you can expect from a full game.

- Major parts of the demo have been completely reworked
- Added difficulty settings
- Better performance, especially on low-end PCs
- MANY quality of life changes
- MANY bug fixes
and so much more...

This should be one of the last major updates for the demo, so I would like to thank everyone for your feedback and hope to see you in the full game!

notes.title: Biggest demo hotfix yet
notes.content:
Just deployed biggest demo hotfix yet! This should fix vast majority of remaining problems in the demo.

- Reworked interaction system
- Fixed a bug that could prevent a player from finishing the car scene
- Encounter with Casper and his dog should now be a little bit easier
- Readjusted the location/number of valuables that have to be collected around the graveyard
- Mouse sensitivity can now be correctly adjusted
- Small terrain fixes
- Flashlight now looks much better and more realistic
- A couple of minor bug fixes

notes.title: Quick hotfix
notes.content:
It's been just 24 hours since the demo's release and so far, I'm surprised that everything is working as intended with no reported crashes or game-breaking bugs. However, there have been a couple of small issues that should be resolved with today's hotfix:

- Fixed an issue where opening a menu while interacting with an object could bug out the text on the screen
- Multiple fixes to how the player character interacts with readable objects in the world
- Fixed a couple of spelling mistakes in both languages (Czech and English)
